acceptance: Every adjudication record has candidate ID, context, outcome, rationale, evidence state, and verifier receipt.
title: Define materiality-decision record schema

acceptance: Candidate cannot be material without a concrete statement of which permitted decision path changes if the distinction collapses.
title: Define collapse-counterfactual contract

acceptance: Record separately captures decision, actor/authority, phase, observable consequence, and evidence/provenance.
title: Define decision-consequence fields

acceptance: Outcomes distinguish material, non-material, context-conditioned, duplicate/alias, derived, and unresolved without forced promotion.
title: Define adjudication outcome taxonomy

acceptance: Known inapplicable subject/facet fixtures are rejected before materiality scoring.
title: Implement subject-by-facet applicability predicate

acceptance: Exact duplicates and aliases are classified without silently merging canonical identities.
title: Implement duplicate and alias detector

acceptance: Known left/right inversions resolve to the same semantic distinction with explicit orientation metadata.
title: Implement inverse-distinction detector

acceptance: Known refinement/generalization fixtures produce explicit relation evidence rather than new independent primitives.
title: Implement refinement and generalization detector

acceptance: Candidates derivable from existing primitives are marked derived with a witness path.
title: Implement composition and logical-implication detector

acceptance: Classifier distinguishes independent witness dimensions from correlated observations and records uncertainty.
title: Implement independence versus correlation classifier

acceptance: Fixtures include plausible wording with no decision consequence and must not promote.
title: Create adversarial non-material candidate fixtures

acceptance: Adjudicator produces all defined outcomes and cannot default every candidate to material.
title: Implement materiality adjudicator from explicit gates

acceptance: Every rejected/unresolved candidate has stable ID, reason, evidence state, and rediscovery key.
title: Emit rejection and unresolved residual ledger

acceptance: Run accounts for all generated candidates and reports counts by domain, facet, and outcome with no missing IDs.
title: Dry-run all generated candidates and emit before/after statistics

acceptance: A repeat pass yields zero new canonical candidates; unresolved candidates remain residuals rather than auto-promotions.
title: Re-saturate the adjudicated basis to a zero-new pass
